learningGoals: Recite a classic poem with proper rhythm, intonation, and pauses. 🎶
Understand the concept that small things combine to make very big things. 🌍
Identify rhyming words at the end of the poem's lines (e.g., sand/land). 🔤
Learn vocabulary related to nature and geography, such as ocean and land. 🗺️
Appreciate the value of small acts of kindness and love. 💖
conversationStarters: Can you imagine how many drops of water are in the big blue ocean? 🌊
Have you ever tried to count the grains of sand on a beach or in a sandbox? 🏖️
What is a small, kind thing you can do for a friend today? 😊
teachingTips: Clap your hands or tap a table to find the beat and rhythm of the poem together. 👏
Use a globe or a world map to show the difference between land (grains of sand) and oceans (drops of water). 🌍
Highlight the rhyming words and ask your child to think of other words that rhyme with them. 🗣️
Discuss how small efforts (like reading one page a day) lead to big results. 📚
Encourage your child to memorize the poem by reciting one line a day. 🧠

funActivities.title: Dropper Art 🎨
funActivities.description: Use an eyedropper or a wet paintbrush to drop colored water onto paper. Watch how little drops spread and merge to make big colorful shapes.

funActivities.title: Sand Tracing ✍️
funActivities.description: Pour a thin layer of sand or salt onto a baking tray. Let your child practice writing the new vocabulary words or drawing waves using their finger.

funActivities.title: The Kindness Jar ❤️
funActivities.description: Find an empty jar. Every time your child does a 'little' act of kindness, drop a small bead or coin into it until the jar is full!
